title: AI doesn't learn from its mistakes. Your system should.
excerpt: Your agent doesn't remember it got something wrong yesterday. If you want it not to happen again, what has to change is the system it works in. How to turn a repeated mistake into a change that stays, and why writing it in a file isn't always enough.
seo_title: AI agents that repeat mistakes: the system loop
seo_description: Your agent doesn't remember yesterday's mistake. How to turn a repeated mistake into a permanent change, and why a written rule isn't always enough.
alt: An AI agent trips three times over the same pothole; further on the pothole is filled and a hand places the last block of a wall.
